panels.title: Grid Load & Solar Generation by Zone (1-min windows)
panels.description: rt_zone_metrics, speed layer. Each series is one grid_zone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS "time", grid_zone, total_consumption_kwh AS "consumption_kwh" FROM rt_zone_metrics WHERE window_type = 'tumbling_1m' AND $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY window_start

panels.title: Current Renewable Contribution by Zone
panels.description: Latest tumbling_1m window per zone. The brief's 'renewable contribution considerably low' alert fires on this.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (grid_zone) grid_zone AS "Zone", renewable_pct AS "renewable_pct", active_meter_count AS "Active Meters", window_end AS "As Of" FROM rt_zone_metrics WHERE window_type = 'tumbling_1m' ORDER BY grid_zone, window_start DESC
SELECT count(*) AS "Open Alerts" FROM alerts WHERE resolved_at IS NULL

panels.title: Latest Reconciled Daily Billing (top 20 by net amount)

targets.rawSql: SELECT business_date AS "Date", household_id AS "Household", grid_zone AS "Zone", total_consumption_kwh AS "kWh", net_amount AS "Net Amount", currency AS "Currency" FROM daily_household_billing WHERE business_date = (SELECT max(business_date) FROM daily_household_billing) ORDER BY net_amount DESC LIMIT 20
